Our Purpose

Our Mission

To provide every learner with a high-quality, inclusive education that fosters intellectual curiosity, personal growth, and lifelong love of learning — equipping them with the skills and values they need to thrive in a changing world.

Our Vision

To be a beacon of excellence in our community — a school where every child, regardless of background or circumstance, is empowered to reach their full potential and contribute meaningfully to society.

What we stand for

Academic Excellence

We hold every learner to high standards while providing the support they need to meet them.

Inclusivity

Every child belongs here. We celebrate diversity and create space for every voice to be heard.

Compassion

We lead with empathy — understanding the realities our learners face and responding with care.

Growth

We believe every learner has untapped potential, and we dedicate ourselves to helping it flourish.

Safety & Respect

A safe, respectful environment is the foundation on which all meaningful learning is built.

Edendale Primary School has been serving the Manenberg community with dedication, compassion, and a commitment to excellence in education.

Enter to Learn , Leave to Serve

A Place of Learning, Growth & Community

Edendale Primary School is a public primary school situated in Manenberg on the Cape Flats in Cape Town, Western Cape. We offer education from Grade R through to Grade 7, providing a safe and nurturing learning environment for every child.

Our candle emblem reflects our core belief: that education is the light that guides every learner toward a brighter future. No matter the challenges our community faces, we remain steadfast in our commitment to every child in our care.

400+
Learners
20+
Teachers
Gr R–7
Grades Offered

Our Purpose

Our Mission

To provide every learner with a high-quality, inclusive education that fosters intellectual curiosity, personal growth, and a lifelong love of learning — equipping them with the skills and values they need to thrive in a changing world.

Our Vision

To be a beacon of excellence in our community — a school where every child, regardless of background or circumstance, is empowered to reach their full potential and contribute meaningfully to society.

What we stand for

Academic Excellence

We hold every learner to high standards while providing the support they need to meet them.

Inclusivity

Every child belongs here. We celebrate diversity and create space for every voice to be heard.

Compassion

We lead with empathy — understanding the realities our learners face and responding with care.

Growth

We believe every learner has untapped potential, and we dedicate ourselves to helping it flourish.

Safety & Respect

A safe, respectful environment is the foundation on which all meaningful learning is built.

Rooted in Manenberg, Reaching Beyond

Manenberg is a vibrant community on the Cape Flats with a rich history and a resilient spirit. Like many communities in the area, it faces real socioeconomic challenges — but the people here are defined by far more than their circumstances.

Edendale Primary stands as a cornerstone of this community. We are more than a school — we are a gathering point, a support system, and a source of hope for hundreds of families.

We serve learners from households facing poverty and high unemployment, providing not just education but stability and structure.
In a community affected by gangsterism and substance abuse, our school offers a safe alternative — a place where children can simply be children and learn.
We recognise the challenges around parental involvement, and actively work to build bridges between the school and the families we serve.
We are committed to improving literacy and numeracy outcomes so our learners are prepared for high school and beyond.

© Edendale Primary School. All rights reserved. | 100 Philippi Ring Road & Manenburg Ave, Manenburg, Cape Town, 7764
